description: This file defines the class MessageOnlyLogFilter, a filter for log output that passes only messages to the next node in the logging chain, discarding other metadata.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters log entries, passing only the message to the next node.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filtering method that passes only the message part of the log to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
